description: Opens the chat for one of the person's purchases or sales, where buyer and seller arrange the pickup: messages, the agreed pickup time and the address; or a conversation of questions before buying (enq_ ids). Shows it as a card. Without sale_id, their most recent one. agentPickup never shares either side's contact details; they share what they choose in the chat once the buyer has paid. Needs sign-in.

as.description: Only when the person is both buyer and seller (a test): which side to act as.

sale_id.description: A purchase (sale_...) or questions before buying (enq_...).

name: open_deal
title: Open a deal's chat
